title: Domus Extension Manifest
description: Schema definition for Domus OS Smart Home extension manifests (WASM/WASI plugins, Blueprints, Widgets).

$schema.description: URI or relative path of the JSON Schema for validation.

id.description: Unique reverse-domain identifier for the extension (e.g. domus.wasi.sunspec-modbus).

tier.description: Verification tier: 'verified' (official Domus team) or 'community' (open-source community).

license.description: Open source SPDX license identifier (e.g. Apache-2.0, MIT, GPL-3.0).

repository_url.description: Public open source repository URL (e.g. GitHub or GitLab).

description.description: Comprehensive explanation of what the extension does and its supported devices.

entrypoint.description: Primary binary entrypoint (e.g. plugin.wasm) or script.

capabilities.description: List of sandboxed capabilities requested by the plugin (e.g. wasi:serial-port, energy:read, events:write).

configuration.description: Configurable parameters presented to the user in the Domus UI.

description.description: User-facing description of the configuration option.
